subject: Clearinghouse: weekly readout — priorities & decisions needed
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-onboarding@cloudmarket.io
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Clearinghouse: weekly readout — priorities & decisions needed

Team — sharing a compact readout ahead of Wednesday's QBR prep slot. TL;DR: OKRs are broadly on track, we have three things that need quick decisions and two risks to surface. Attached: one-pager + latency chart.

Wins
- Hosted API latency P50 improved by 12% vs last week after kernel swap (see chart).
- Completed Dedicated onboarding for CloudMarket POC; partner engineers verified API flow.
- Two production customers (Acme Analytics, Nova Insights) signed on to pilot the new caching policy.

Risks/Issues
- Prefix cache invalidations caused a rare spike on 9/25; root cause narrowed to edge router config but we need decision on rolling back the config vs incremental patch. Impact: intermittent 300ms tail latency for <1% of requests.
- Hiring: we are two backend infra hires behind plan; without approvals we risk slower rollout of quantization profiles in Q4.

Asks (decision required before Wednesday)
1) Approve emergency rollback of edge config to previous stable version (recommended) OR approve canary patch plan (will take 48h). I recommend rollback to mitigate customer risk.
2) Approve two backend infra headcounts (SWE-III or equivalent) to be posted this quarter; we will offset by delaying one non-critical infra project.
3) Confirm we’ll present the CloudMarket onboarding story in the partner segment (Kate from CloudMarket is looped).

Notes: I put a short QBR draft in Drive (link below). If we can get decisions 1+2 by EOD Tuesday I will finalize slides.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Production Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_one_pager.pdf (summary), prefix-latency-chart.png (P50/P95 trends)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, partner-onboarding@cloudmarket.io
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse: weekly readout — priorities & decisions needed

Markus — thanks for the crisp summary. A few inline notes and a small suggestion on the slides.

> Wins — great to see latency move; can we annotate the slide with the kernel patch commit SHA so it’s reproducible in the appendix?

Agree on the rollback recommendation for the edge config. Recommendation: schedule rollback at 10:00pm PT tonight with the usual rollback play (30m window). Please coordinate SRE runbook updates and notify the two pilot customers pre-rollback.

On hiring — approve two postings but set interviews to prioritize candidates with experience in attention-optimized runtimes. We will reallocate the non-critical infra project as you suggested; inform product leads today so they can replan.

For the CloudMarket section: yes, Kate should present a 2–3 minute partner testimony. Ask: Kate, can you confirm availability for Wed's 11:30am slot?

One more ask: add a single slide showing cost delta of current caching vs proposed (expected 6–9% token-cost reduction). That will help finance and sales dialectically.

Laura
Chief of Staff
